title: My SIL Forged a Dissolution and Sold My Patterns for $550K. So I Made Her Trim Samples.
description: I emptied my $95,000 IRA to start a historic wallpaper company with my sister‑in‑law, only for her to forge a dissolution, sell everything to a museum for $550,000, and toss me a $4,000 finder’s fee. I found the notarized original in my late husband’s desk, voided the entire sale, and now she trims samples in my shop while every roll ships with a QR code to the judgment. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #WallpaperCompany
thumb_text: SHE STOLE MY $550K PATTERNS, NOW SHE TRIMS THEM FOR ME
pinned_comment: What would you do if your own sister‑in‑law forged a dissolution to steal your $95,000 company, sold it to a museum for $550,000, and then handed you a $4,000 finder’s fee like she was doing you a favor? Share your story in the comments.
